description: Point-in-time evidence about the hosted production project, used as a fixture by scripts/reconcile/reconcile-migrations.mjs. That script never connects to a hosted database. Nothing here proves the current live schema: every item is a dated observation and must be re-confirmed by an authorised read-only probe before any rollout. The companion catalog snapshot scripts/reconcile/evidence/production-2026-11-14-catalog-probe.json (read-only queries, 2026-11-14) supersedes catalogFacts for `classify`.

ledgerSummary.source: Supabase migration-history metadata, read once on 2026-11-14 via the read-only list_migrations connector call (project bdbaqpevwmgdvghszjno).
observations: 35 ledger entries were added between 2026-11-10 (86 entries, last 20261108000200) and 2026-11-14 (121 entries, last 20261112000100).
All entries from 20261108000300 onward carry no name, so name matching is impossible for them; matching is by version only.

Many entries still carry console-generated versions and repeated names, and some names do not exist in the repository (for example initial_schema, trial_entitlements, counter_orders, cash_collection).
Because production SQL was applied under other names and versions, 'no same-named entry' does not prove a file's SQL was never run.

catalogFacts.source: UNCHANGED from the 2026-11-10 fixture (Phase 2 read-only catalog inspection). NOT re-observed for the function bodies listed here; the 2026-11-14 catalog probe supersedes these facts for classification purposes.
functionsPresent: place_public_order with six arguments, executable by anon
notes: Function-body hashes above are Phase 2 observations; the 2026-11-14 probe re-observes md5(prosrc) for every public function and is the current authority for drift detection.

The Phase 2 document reports a user-run restore of a production dump that accepted the 14 files 20261109000100..20261110000400 in one transaction after the place_order overload fix. That rehearsal was not observed by any agent and did not include the four 202611080070..10 files.

repositoryFilesWithoutSameNamedEntry.method: Each repository file version was compared with the versions in the 121-entry ledger read on 2026-11-14. Files with a null-named ledger entry at the same version are counted as recorded.
repositoryFilesWithoutSameNamedEntry.note: 20261021000004 and 20261107080000 exist in the ledger with null names, so name matching is impossible and they are listed as unrecorded legacy observations, not as pending.
